synth.notes:
Cursor (player) moves between editable-glyph columns: action 3 = left, action 4 = right, wrapping around.
The list of columns is built from the x positions of the editable glyphs in the state, so nothing is hardcoded.
Actions 1/2/5/7 change no visible field (the objects carry no pixels, so glyph cycling cannot be seen).
Unconfirmed: a click (action 6) inside a column selects it.
Unconfirmed: the move_counter HUD never changes in these observations.
